build: keep helm @spartan-ng/brain peer in sync with releases (#1561)

helm pinned its @spartan-ng/brain peer to the stale pre-1.0 0.0.1-alpha.720 while brain is now
1.0.0, so helm:lint (nx dependency-checks) errored on main and every branch off it. The release
already syncs the peer (prepare-manual-release runs lint --fix), but @semantic-release/git never
committed libs/helm/package.json - it was not in assets - so the fix was discarded each release.

Pin the peer to 1.0.0 and add libs/helm/package.json to the git assets so the sync persists from
the next release on.

ci: publish releases on push to main/beta/alpha (#1559)

The first 1.0.0 release was cut manually via workflow_dispatch; re-enable the push trigger so every
merge to a release branch publishes automatically, which is the point of the channel model. Safe to
leave on: non-releasing commit types (ci/docs/chore/...) compute "no release" and publish nothing,
and the release commit carries [skip ci].

fix: stop CDK backdrop fade doubling the overlay open animation (#1562)

* fix: stop CDK backdrop fade doubling the overlay open animation (#1560)

The overlay backdrop is faded by both CDK prebuilt opacity transition and the spartan overlay
class tw-animate keyframe. Both run on open and visibly double up on iOS, producing the reported
flicker. Drop CDK duplicate fade so the spartan keyframe is the sole animator - one fade everywhere.

The spartan keyframe itself does not smoothly interpolate on Safari/iOS due to an upstream
tw-animate-css bug (blur in its keyframes, see tw-animate-css issue 59), so on iOS the backdrop
appears in one step rather than a smooth fade. Tracked upstream; out of scope here.

Closes #1555

ci: push contributors update via release app to bypass main ruleset

The update-contributors job pushed to main with the default github.token, which
is not a bypass actor on the branch ruleset, so the push was rejected. Mint the
same GitHub App token used by release.yml and check out with it so add-and-commit
pushes as the bypass actor. Switch the message to a non-releasing docs: type.

ci: scope contributors app token and stop persisting it in git config

Address review feedback. Pin the GitHub App token to contents:write instead of
inheriting the installation's full scopes, and check out with credential
persistence disabled so the bypass-actor token is never written to .git/config.
add-and-commit@v9 cannot push with an injected token (its github_token is
API-only), so commit and push manually, applying the token inline only on the
push. The default job token is now read-only.

ci: backmerge release branches down the prerelease ladder

After a release, propagate the release commit and any main-only hotfixes
down main -> beta -> alpha so the release branches never diverge. Uses
merges (not rebase/reset) to stay within the non-fast-forward ruleset, the
release App token to push past branch protection, and a CI-skip marker on
the merge commit to avoid re-firing the verify+release pipeline on every
sync.

Runs after any real release (push, or a workflow_dispatch with
dry-run=false) so a manual release cannot skip the sync. A merge conflict
stops the job and opens a PR to resolve by hand.

ci: guard release commits by chore(release) prefix instead of the skip-ci token

The skip-ci token semantic-release stamps into release commits skips ALL
workflows for that commit, on push AND pull_request. Any promotion/sync PR
whose tip is a release commit then has its required checks skipped and can
never merge.

Drop the token and instead guard ci, cli-smoke and release so they skip
release commits only on push (via a chore(release): prefix check) while
always running on pull_request. Loop/waste prevention on release-branch
pushes is preserved; PR checks now report.

Also make the backmerge self-heal a missing downstream branch (e.g. one
deleted by a promotion PR merge) instead of failing on a missing remote ref.
ci: guard the e2e job too so release commits skip it (review follow-up)

fix(cli): resolve @spartan-ng/brain to the running cli version

When the target workspace does not pin @spartan-ng/cli,
getInstalledPackageVersion returned null for the derived
@spartan-ng/brain version. On pnpm that null reached nx's catalog
check (version.startsWith('catalog:')) and crashed the ui generator
with "Cannot read properties of null (reading 'startsWith')".

Fall back to the running cli's own version so brain always gets a
valid, lockstep specifier instead of null.

Closes #1613

fix(cli): declare missing transitive primitive dependencies

Several primitives imported helm libraries their dependency map did
not declare, so generating them on their own scaffolded code that
imported a never-created library:

- command -> input-group, dialog
- date-picker -> input-group
- dialog -> button
- tabs -> button
- tooltip -> utils

Add a drift-guard test that fails when a template imports a primitive
the map does not declare, so this cannot regress.

Closes #1618

fix(resizable): stop NG0103 feedback loop from non-idempotent layout sync

_synchronizePanelSizes fell into the proportional-rescale branch whenever the
model already equalled the applied layout (a zero-velocity drag frame that
recomputes identical percentages). That branch round-trips each size through
x/total*100, which is not bit-identical for fractional layouts, so the drifted
result was written back to the model, re-triggering the afterRenderEffect. In
zoneless apps this occasionally fails to converge within Angular's retry budget
and throws NG0103.

Short-circuit the reconcile as a no-op when neither the external layout nor the
panel membership changed, and make the layout comparison tolerance-based
(_layoutsEquivalent) so sub-nanopercent drift can no longer register as a change.

Closes #1614

fix(cli): stop escaping quotes in generated attribute selectors

The style transform rewrites component class strings via ts-morph's
setLiteralValue, which keeps the literal's single-quote kind and
backslash-escapes inner quotes. A selector like
[&_ng-icon:not([class*='text-'])] then ships as [class*=\'text-\'], and
Tailwind emits a rule whose class selector carries the backslashes,
which never matches the unescaped class the DOM actually receives - the
class is present but no CSS is generated.

Re-emit values that contain single quotes as double-quoted literals so
the attribute selectors survive verbatim.

Also rename the two style-transform specs from .test.ts to .spec.ts so
the vitest config (src/**/*.spec.ts) actually runs them, and add a
cli-smoke assertion that the icon-sizing rule reaches the built CSS.

Closes #1572

fix(cli): validate cli self-version before brain fallback

Normalize the version read from the cli's own package.json via semver coerce and fail fast
with a clear message if it is missing, so a malformed self-version cannot silently propagate
a nullish brain specifier - the same failure class the original null-version bug fell into.

fix: avoid inline style attributes blocked by strict CSP

Under a strict Content-Security-Policy whose style-src has no
'unsafe-inline', the browser strips inline style attributes. brn-radio
hid its native input via a literal style attribute and
brn-accordion-content applied its host style via [attr.style]; both are
blocked, leaving two radio controls per option and un-clipped accordion
content. Bind through [style] instead so styles apply via CSSOM, which
CSP does not govern.

Closes #1584

feat: allow overriding brn-radio, brn-checkbox and brn-switch host styles

Expose the previously hard-coded visually-hidden and display styles as
inputs. brn-radio gains an `inputStyles` input and brn-checkbox and
brn-switch gain a `hostStyles` input. Defaults are unchanged, so this is
non-breaking. All are bound through `[style]`, keeping them CSP-safe
while letting consumers who need a different hiding technique override
them.

fix(cli): stop escaping quotes in html-in-strings selectors

Route applyToHtmlInStrings through setClassLiteral like the hlm and cva
sites so inline-HTML class rewrites can't reintroduce the escaped-quote
attribute selectors that broke icon styling in issue 1572.

test: update ui-api snapshot for new brn style inputs

Regenerate the generate-ui-docs public-API snapshot to include the
inputStyles input on brn-radio and the hostStyles inputs on brn-checkbox
and brn-switch.

fix(pagination): position sr-only label relative to pagination link (#1635)

The iconOnly mode of hlm-pagination-previous/next renders its label
with the sr-only class, which uses position: absolute. Without a
positioning context on the pagination link, the span resolves its
containing block to the initial containing block and escapes any
inner scroll container, inflating the document scroll height and
producing a page-level scrollbar in app-shell layouts.

Adding relative to HlmPaginationLink keeps the sr-only label
positioned inside the link, using the same approach as the earlier
radio-group overflow patch.

Fixes #1634

fix(combobox): prevent Tab in popup input from focusing browser address bar #1671

When hlm-combobox-input is rendered inside a CDK overlay via
*hlmComboboxPortal, the input lives outside the normal DOM tree.
Pressing Tab found no further tabbable elements in the overlay and
cycled focus to the browser's address bar.

Fix by intercepting Tab in popup mode: preventDefault stops the browser
from handling the key, selectActiveItem + close collapse the popup, and
BrnOverlay._restoreFocus then returns focus to the trigger so the user
can continue tabbing through the page normally.

fix(popover): anchor to the opposite edge when content does not fit (#1700)

Both attach positions share the same align axis, so a trigger near a
viewport edge leaves the CDK without a candidate that fits. It then
confines the overlay to the gap beside the trigger, and content
declaring w-72 renders around 68px wide. The content is not clipped,
it is squeezed.

Add the mirrored pair of positions as a fallback. The CDK picks the
first candidate that fits entirely, so the overlay changes anchor
instead of being compressed. Push stays disabled: re-enabling it would
bring back the drift that turning it off had removed, and falling back
to another anchor needs no push at all.

Closes #1283

fix: forward the scroll strategy input through the helm overlay wrappers (#1709)

* fix: forward the scroll strategy input through the helm overlay wrappers

BrnOverlay declares a `scrollStrategy` input, but none of the helm
wrappers around BrnPopover list it among the host directive inputs, so
an application cannot reach it. The default reposition behaviour is the
only one available, and there is no way to opt out of it.

That matters when a trigger scrolls underneath a sticky header: the
overlay keeps following it and is drawn over the header, because the
CDK measures the whole viewport and knows nothing about the app chrome.
Closing on scroll is the usual way out, and it was unreachable.

Forward the input on select, select-multiple, combobox, autocomplete
and popover. Nothing changes by default: the input keeps falling back
to the reposition strategy the tokens already provide.

The new story pins a popover to `scrollStrategy='close'`. Without the
forwarding the binding is silently ignored, the overlay stays open, and
the spec fails on the content still being in the DOM.

* chore: update snapshot
